name: Jubal
title: Father of Music
summary: Jubal was a descendant of Cain and the son of Lamech and Adah. He is regarded as the ancestor of all who play the lyre and the flute, making him the first musician mentioned in the Bible. His significance lies in representing the development of culture and art in early human history.

keyEvents.title: Jubal's Lineage from Cain
keyEvents.description: Jubal descends from Cain through Lamech. He belongs to the Cainite line that developed various cultural and technological skills.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of Musicians
keyEvents.description: Jubal is described as the father of all who play the lyre and flute, making him the biblical origin of musical performance.

keyEvents.title: Son of Lamech and Adah
keyEvents.description: Jubal was the second son of Lamech and his wife Adah. His brother Jabal became the ancestor of nomadic herdsmen.

keyEvents.title: Part of the development of the Cainite civilization
keyEvents.description: Together with his brothers Jabal and Tubal-cain, Jubal represents the emergence of specialized professions and cultural expressions in early human civilization after the Fall.

keyEvents.title: The place of music in biblical tradition
keyEvents.description: Jubal's role as the originator of music points forward to the central place of music in biblical worship, as later expressed in the Book of Psalms and temple worship.
